steps.name: a fresh install offers two choices and no fields

steps.message: Wrong passcode. Ask your Host for a new one.
steps.name: a wrong passcode is refused in one line under it
a keystroke replaces the refused passcode and clears its line
the Paste button fills the passcode from a Join Link and moves to the username
Join creates the Person and signs in
a relaunch reads the key back from the keychain
Settings shows the Person's name and a Sign-in Code in slots, copies it, and shows no Host sections
the copied Sign-in Code pastes into the slots and signs the device back in
